# Hole in the Sky

Journal: `ep1/quests/main_quest/q301_finding_myers` · `MainQuest` · hash `2713613091`.

Journal premise: Songbird. Real pretty handle for the lethal netjock who just blasted into the Relic from a hijacked plane. Which just crash landed in that dump called Dogtown. Go on li'l soldier, run along and rescue NUS President Rosalind Myers. Assumin' it's not too late. If I missed anything, it's 'cause I'm busy writin' all this shit down for posterity – I don't like our chances here one bit.
